instruction: Candid full-length documentary photograph of an outdoor concrete pathway with a chain-link fence in soft daylight. On the left, the blonde woman in a white dress (R2) walks forward holding a bouquet, looking down at her hands. On the right, the person with the shaved head in a black dress (R1) walks beside her, also looking down. They walk side-by-side, holding hands with their gazes directed downward at their clasped hands. The lighting is soft and natural.
